title: BC Friday Tips #51 Dimension No. in Dimension Value
summary: The Dimension Value table contains a hidden Global Dimension No. field that reveals which shortcut dimension a dimension code belongs to, avoiding the need to check General Ledger Setup and improving lookup performance.
key_points: Business Central supports 8 shortcut dimensions configured in General Ledger Setup
Dimension Value table has a hidden Global Dimension No. field
Using this field avoids checking General Ledger Setup separately

quotes.text: the Dimension Value table has a hidden field called Global Dimension No.
quotes.why_it_matters: Reveals the existence of an undocumented field that enables faster dimension identification

quotes.text: use this hidden field to find the dimension number instantly
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the practical benefit of using this field instead of manual lookups
